required_preflight: Use the normal admin ARBio session and the canonical payment-condition configuration reader.
Match the complete UUID beginning 5c4f35f8; never cast or complete the prefix by assumption.
Confirm that the active condition assigned to this exact partner is the intended V2 synthetic plan.
Read the current activation mode, complete pilot_partner_ids and version immediately before saving.
Confirm that every existing pilot partner remains selected.
forbidden: SQL or hosted writes by the agent
Replacing the current pilot array with only the new partner
Treating partner financial defaults as a buyer payment choice
Sending an order without the buyer explicitly choosing the payment method
buyer_acceptance_after_admin_activation: Reopen or refresh the condition so the options reader returns mode=required for the new partner.
The payment-method selector must remain visible and no legacy simulation may be reused while it is refetched.
Select Boleto explicitly; financial configuration never selects it for the buyer.
Confirm one installment, the server-computed total and the label Parcelas estimadas.
Confirm that the note states that the definitive due date counts from fiscal-invoice issue, not from the order date.
Only then may the UI enable Enviar pedido; the auditor decides whether any real submission is separately authorized.
negative_acceptance: The legacy writer for the newly activated partner must fail with B2B_PAYMENT_CONDITION_REQUIRED and create no order.
Partners outside the pilot and other tenants must remain in their prior mode.
A stale activation CAS must change nothing and must not retry automatically.
external_effects: NF, receivables, collections, external delivery and communication remain blocked
